blurb: Guests take boat tours on the Intracoastal Waterway and surrounding coastal areas to see dolphins, manatees, turtles, and birds. Tours are private or semi-private with a maximum of 6 passengers, led by USCG-licensed captains. The tours include narration about local wildlife, history, and conservation efforts.
